apple.name: Mosselora
apple.subtitle: A Living Garden
apple.description:
Restore a village stream one pipe puzzle at a time. Rotate tiles to connect the spring to the garden, watch water reach the route, then choose what to restore: shade trees, a footbridge or wildflowers.

Your choice changes the next stream and the village story. Follow twelve chapters, revisit your journal and see how a small set of decisions combine. Optional hints, undo and restart let you take the puzzle at your own pace.

Play offline, without an account or network connection. Progress is saved on this device.
